# intutic_sop_optimizer_settings <Badge type="warning" text="Biz Org+" />

The SOP Optimizer's approval mode (Labs › SOP Optimizer › Approval mode): whether a manually triggered optimizer run may apply a strengthening proposal without review. It replaces the removed `featureFlags.ff_metaclaw_auto_apply` key of `intutic_workspace_settings`. One per workspace; the OWNER or ADMIN role writes it. Destroying the resource sets the mode back to `manual` and keeps the threshold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let a manually triggered optimizer run apply strengthening proposals that
# score 0.9 or more without review. Destroying this sets the mode back to
# "manual".
resource "intutic_sop_optimizer_settings" "this" {
  mode           = "auto"
  auto_threshold = 0.9
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `manual`: nothing is applied automatically; every proposal waits for review. `auto`: a manually triggered run applies a proposal without review when its score reaches `auto_threshold` and its change classification is `STRENGTHEN`; every other proposal still waits for review.

### Optional

- `auto_threshold` (Number) The score (0–1, at most three decimal places) a proposal must reach to be auto-applied in `auto`. Omit it to keep the workspace's current threshold (0.85 when it never set one).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace id.

## Import

```shell
# Import by workspace id: the provider key's workspace, the only one it can
# manage. Any other id is refused ("Wrong workspace").
terraform import intutic_sop_optimizer_settings.this ws_0123456789abcdef
```
